# Hosts (generated)

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/workflow.py render from adapters/hosts.json and workflow/registry.json. -->

The same skills, commands and role agents run on ZCode, Claude Code, Grok and Codex. Packets and state always name the logical role `sdlc-workflow:<role>`; only the spawn call uses the host's type below. Identify the host from the tools you have (a Skill tool and plugin agent types, or Codex's `spawn_agent`); when unsure, try the native role type first.

| Host | Manifest | Commands | Spawn a hat as | Generic fallback | Invoke a procedure | Reviewer/qc read-only |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ZCode | `.zcode-plugin/plugin.json` | `/sdlc`, `/sdlc-product`, … from commands/ | `sdlc-workflow:<role>` | `general-purpose` | Skill tool `sdlc-workflow:<name>`; users type `$<name>` | reviewer/qc tool allowlist + disallowedTools |
| Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` | `/sdlc`, `/sdlc-product`, … (qualified `/sdlc-workflow:sdlc` when names collide) | `sdlc-workflow:<role>` | `general-purpose` | Skill tool `sdlc-workflow:<name>`; users type `/sdlc-workflow:<name>` | reviewer/qc tool allowlist + disallowedTools |
| Grok | `.grok-plugin/plugin.json` | `/sdlc`, `/sdlc-product`, … (qualified `/sdlc-workflow:sdlc` when ambiguous) | `sdlc-workflow:<role>` | `general-purpose` | Skill tool `sdlc-workflow:<name>`; users type `/<name>` | reviewer/qc tool allowlist + disallowedTools |
| Codex | `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` | none — Codex plugins carry no commands; see the command table below | `sdlc-workflow-<role>` | `default` | read the listed SKILL.md (Codex lists `sdlc-workflow:<name>`); users pick it with `$` or `/skills` | reviewer/qc agents set sandbox_mode = "read-only"; the generic fallback only has the packet rule |

## Spawning and fallback

Spawn the native role type once. If the host reports an unknown type, spawn **once** as that host's generic type with the same packet; its first action reads `PLUGIN_ROOT/agents/<role>.md` and the primary SKILL.md. Record `host_spawn.<role>` with the host, the type tried and the fallback used. Never dispatch both forms. On Codex without installed role agents the fallback is the normal path; install them with `python3 PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/install-codex-agents.py --project <project root>` so reviewer/qc also get a read-only sandbox. With the generic fallback the read-only rule is only the packet's, so check the record's write observation before accepting a review.

## PLUGIN_ROOT

PLUGIN_ROOT is two directories above the running `SKILL.md` (the folder with `skills/`, `agents/`, `scripts/`). ZCode also exports `$ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT` to the shell; Claude Code (`CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`) and Grok (`GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT`) set theirs only for hooks and MCP servers. Codex runs an installed copy under `~/.codex/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/sdlc-workflow/<version>/`: resolve PLUGIN_ROOT from that copy, and reinstall after the source changes. Pass the absolute PLUGIN_ROOT in every packet.

## Commands on hosts without plugin commands

Codex plugins carry skills only. Invoke the command's skill and state the mode in the request; the skill treats an explicit `mode:` (or the command name, such as `/sdlc-product`) exactly like the command.

| Command | Skill | Mode | Codex request (pick the skill with `$` or `/skills`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/sdlc` | `sdlc-workflow:sdlc` | `auto` | `sdlc-workflow:sdlc` + `mode: auto <arguments>` |
| `/sdlc-discover` | `sdlc-workflow:discover` | `full` | `sdlc-workflow:discover` + `mode: full <arguments>` |
| `/sdlc-eval` | `sdlc-workflow:sdlc-eval` | `eval` | `sdlc-workflow:sdlc-eval` + `mode: eval <arguments>` |
| `/sdlc-grok` | `sdlc-workflow:imagery` | `auth` | `sdlc-workflow:imagery` + `mode: auth <arguments>` |
| `/sdlc-product` | `sdlc-workflow:sdlc` | `product` | `sdlc-workflow:sdlc` + `mode: product <arguments>` |
| `/sdlc-research` | `sdlc-workflow:discover` | `research` | `sdlc-workflow:discover` + `mode: research <arguments>` |
| `/sdlc-review` | `sdlc-workflow:sdlc` | `review-only` | `sdlc-workflow:sdlc` + `mode: review-only <arguments>` |
